item.title: Fake OpenAI, SpaceX events used to steal Microsoft, Google accounts
item.description: Hackers are using fake OpenAI, SpaceX, and Anthropic event invitations to lure employees into phishing attacks, using two different phishing-as-a-service platforms to steal Microsoft and Google account credentials and authentication sessions. [...]

item.title: AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research
item.description: An unreleased OpenAI cyber model found and exploited 948 distinct Linux kernel privilege escalation bugs for about $1.2 million. The post AI Agents Got Root on Linux via 948 Kernel Flaws in OpenAI Research appeared first on SecurityWeek .

item.title: Russian state-linked hackers target iPhone, Android devices in zero-click espionage campaign
item.description: Russian state-linked hackers targeted users in Ukraine, the United States and Europe in a campaign to steal sensitive information from iPhone and Android devices, researchers found.
